_doc: Survey closure and boundary-corner classes per country (ISO code). Offered only while that country is an active market. Every class names its source; status to_verify means the pack author has not yet checked the table against the source, so the class is offered for the surveyor to pick and is never applied on its own. Each class also carries the edition year of its source and the clause where known.
